title: The Double Rainbow in the Hose Mist
youtube_title: The Double Rainbow in the Hose Mist | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Kito finds a small rainbow in the hose mist. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Kito shows Hadi how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
